messages:
Alex: Quick question — for the console audit panel and the NDJSON export, do we want to include a normalized "change_origin" field (ip/region/service) + optional actor context (email/actor_id) by default?
Priya: My first instinct is to keep actor details off by default for exports to reduce PII exposure. include a toggle? :thinking:
Tomas: Agree on toggle. Also we should attach a trace_id when available so downstream SIEM can correlate events. small sample: ```{
  "change_origin": {
    "service": "console",
    "region": "eu-west-1",
    "ip": "redacted"
  },
  "trace_id": "fd4a2c7e"
}```
Jules: If we add a toggle, we need clear UX & docs: 
- export page checkbox: "Include actor identifiers (email, user id)"
- tooltip: "Including identifiers increases audit usefulness but may contain PII; use with retention policies"
Samir: From quota/retention POV exports with actor fields should count against higher retention tier. We already have infra that tags exports as PII-sensitive for billing/expiry.
Priya: Also need an overwrite/redaction policy for IPs. For EU customers, IP is PII. Maybe default to pseudonymize ip -> ip_fingerprint unless customer has compliance opt-in.
Alex: Good call. Proposal: default export schema includes change_origin.service & region + trace_id. Actor identifiers are off by default; checkbox to opt-in. IPs pseudonymized by default; real IP only included if tenant has opt-in flag.
audit-bot: New export schema PR opened: #4021. CI checks: schema lint OK, but sample fixtures missing region values.
Tomas: We should also emit a lightweight signal in telemetry when exports contain actor identifiers so we can track who uses opt-in. Add telemetry event: `export.audit.include_actor:true`
Jules: UX follow-ups: add inline warning when users enable actor identifiers: 
"Export will include user emails and IDs. Ensure you have consent & appropriate retention settings"
Samir: Ops: ensure faster deletion path for exported bundles flagged PII-sensitive. Otherwise legal will hate us.
Priya: Can we surface per-tenant default in the console header for exports? "Your tenant default: actor identifiers OFF"
Alex: Implementation tasks: 
- eng-platform: add change_origin & trace_id to internal event pipeline (Tomas)
- eng-api: add opt-in query param for export endpoint + tenant flag (Samir)
- console: checkbox + note + tenant default banner (Jules)
- privacy: pseudonymize-ip helper + policy config (Priya)
- docs: update export schema samples and examples (me)
Tomas: I can pick the pipeline change, will create a canary branch and a schema migration.
Priya: I'll draft the pseudonymization rules and legal blurb.
Jules: I'll prototype the checkbox copy. Posting a screenshot in #design after lunch.
Alex: Thanks — if no objections by EOD we'll ship the schema PR to canary. :thumbsup:
Samir: No objections from infra. Will coordinate retention mapping with billing.
Priya: +1 from privacy.
Alex: Cool — moving this to a short RFC then.
